manual.completed_at_basis: Latest captured_at_utc among the five completed original-command journal snapshots. manual-completion.json.at is later metadata assembly time after stopping; it is not used as execution-completion time.

happy.brief_prefix: Normal pick: move the product, receive the reply and check its new position.

drop_ack_after_effect.brief_prefix: The product moves, but the robot's completion reply is deliberately lost.

wms_unavailable.brief_prefix: The first WMS acknowledgement fails after the robot outcome has been verified.

limits: Explicit eight current 9e83 acceptance lab traces, their finalized case/review inputs, current acceptance references, and every settled current manual JSON/JSONL/log/Markdown/text/PNG file. Historical/publication payloads are excluded.
Inventory construction hashes exact bytes; scan/DOM/finalizer results are separate and initially pending.
Manual completion time is bounded by the latest saved completed journal capture before the recorded forced owned-process stop. No launcher exit0 is invented.
Binary images are hashed/accounted by the text scanner without OCR or a fresh pixel review.
No live database, browser, service, tests, renders or remote actions are performed by this saved-file audit.
